描述_EN: this dish is an example of yaozhou wares typical of the northern song dynasty (960-1127). while the wares produced at the yaozhou kiln complex enjoyed popularity from the end of the tang dynasty (618-906) through to the beginning of the yuan dynasty (1279-1368), this dish exhibits the olive green glaze and carved designs common to the yaozhou wares of the northern song period. a green celadon glaze was then applied, and allowed to pool into the crevices of the clay, and to run thin over any raised areas and at the edges. after firing, areas where the glaze ran thick were an opaque olive green and thin areas allowed for the golden brown tone of the body to show through, creating the range of tones visible in this dish. yaouzhou objects were often decorated by creating intaglio floral designs into their surface, either by carving or through the use of moulds.
描述_ZN: 此盘是北宋时期典型的耀州器皿的一个例子（960-1127）。 从唐朝末年（618-906）到元朝初年（1279-1368），耀州窑群生产的器物一直很受欢迎，这只盘子展示了北宋时期耀州器物常见的橄榄绿釉和雕刻图案。 然后涂上绿色的青瓷釉，让其积聚在泥土的缝隙中，并在任何凸起的地方和边缘处流下薄薄的釉。 烧制后，釉层厚的地方是不透明的橄榄绿，而薄的地方则让器身的金棕色调显露出来，形成了这个盘子中可见的各种色调。 耀州器物通常通过雕刻或使用模具在其表面形成凹凸不平的花卉图案来进行装饰。
